WhatsApp has long offered a search function on the chat information screen, but it is now exploring a faster method that can be used directly within the conversation. Details below.

WhatsApp is exploring ways to speed up the search process on iOS

WhatsApp users should know that there are mainly two ways to find old messages within the app. The first is to search from the main conversation list, which searches across all conversations. The second is to search from an individual chat's information screen, which only searches within that conversation.

According to WABetaInfo's findings, WhatsApp may soon add a faster method to help users find old messages within a conversation.

The site points out that the latest WhatsApp beta version distributed through TestFlight contains code related to a search button. When users start scrolling up to view chat history, the button will appear in the lower-right corner of the screen.

WABetaInfo information as follows:

The site mentions that the search tool within a chat will return the same results as the existing search option on the chat information screen. However, the new button should make searching faster, as users no longer need to leave the conversation to use the search function.

WABetaInfo points out that this button has not yet been made available to beta testers, and is still under development. It is expected to be released in a future TestFlight update, followed by an official launch.
